in ADT batch envelopes (POST /sap/bc/adt/communication/batch), per level: the nodestructure POST of every node of the level, recursing into every child node; objects reads several parents in the same envelopes; sequential reads where the system has no communication batch

in ADT batch envelopes (POST /sap/bc/adt/communication/batch), per level of the tree: the structure source GET of every node, then the table source GET of the nodes not found as structures; with include_extensions then the where-used scope POST pair (structure, table) of every node read, the scoped where-used POST of every scope that answered, and the source GETs of every append candidate; structure_names reads several structures in the same envelopes; sequential reads where the system has no communication batch

in ADT batch envelopes (POST /sap/bc/adt/communication/batch): every object's first read (a program's or include's source GET, a function group's nodestructure POST, then its includes node), then per depth up to 20 the source GET of every include first reached there; objects reads several objects in the same envelopes; for a single class one metadata GET; sequential reads where the system has no communication batch
